PDF Edge Preservation in Volume Rendering Using Splatting
Abstract: This paper presents a method to preserve sharp edge details in splatting for volume rendering. Conventional splatting algorithms produce fuzzy images for views close to the volume model. The lack of details in such views greatly hinders study and manipulation of data sets using virtual navigation.
